phases.title: Prerequisites
phases.note: Mostly settled already. Kept visible because each one is a thing that would silently ruin a later phase if it were not true.

checks.expect: Every table is currently readable with the publishable key, including password hashes and children's names. QA generates more real data into a database anyone can read. See OUTSTANDING §0. Migration 0021 revokes the underlying grants on deploy as defence in depth, but the dashboard setting is the fix.

checks.what: Reactivate ben.j.wylie@gmail.com. Run phase-0.sql §1–§2 in the Supabase SQL editor.
checks.expect: It reads is_active = false because the operator edit form used to write that on every save — an absent checkbox read as === "on". Aaron fixed the cause in 0d6bbf0; the row it already wrote still needs repairing. You cannot run Phase 5 without an admin login.

checks.what: Nothing. Stripe stays in test mode for the pass.
checks.expect: Established 2026-08-26: production runs on test keys (livemode=False on a real paid submission), and the whole path already works — those payments reached new and sent_to_coach, so intent, webhook, fulfilment and ladder all ran. Test mode is better for QA: decline and 3-D Secure can be triggered on demand, and nothing is charged. Phase 0a moves to the end — see Phase 11.

checks.expect: With it on, only you can reach the site — which is what you want while generating test submissions.

checks.expect: Arms the instrument. It is already generated and sitting in .env.local; `grep '^QA_TOKEN=' .env.local \
You should be redirected home. Nothing visible changes — that is correct.

checks.what: Confirm the version in the record's own version picker matches the one you were told, and that its label describes the change.
checks.expect: A shared record acquires copies — a pinned link, a stale tab. The host's number is the version; we do not keep a second one, because a page that republishes itself cannot carry an accurate copy of it.

checks.what: Mark one check, then have the trail read back.
checks.expect: The record carries its own instrumentation (Q15), but it cannot post from the viewer sandbox — the trail travels only when the page publishes, which is when somebody marks something. Marking is what proves it works.
